correctness.rationale: For binary words of fixed weight the 2-binomial signature is completely fixed by the scattered 01-count. Rotation increments this count by -k or n-k, hence its normalized partial-sum path has coprime steps +a,-b and period L=a+b. Distinct residues mod L prove the lower bound and force length-L periodicity at equality. A balanced length-L cyclic window always exists by sliding-window averaging and unit differences. Deleting its zero-displacement path segment removes at most L-1 distinct visited heights; induction gives n-d+1. Explicit clustered construction has exactly d-1 overlaps and achieves the bound. Direct scattered-count enumeration checked all 8166 nonconstant binary words of lengths 2..12 and equality classifications.

value.rationale: Cyclic rotations of a source word are a natural restricted family in sequence reconstruction. The 2-binomial fingerprint records only Hamming weight and scattered pair counts. Exact minima and maxima for every content, a complete lower-equality structure and a simple upper-extremizing construction quantify best- and worst-case shift ambiguity over an infinite, motivated parameter family. This is not a parameter renaming or finite-table increment.
